title: Open Source Contributor
description: A 3-month track for getting started: land merged pull requests and open real issues across tracked Olgax projects.
motto: More PRs. More issues. More impact.

title: Open Source Developer
description: A 6-month track for hands-on shipping: merge a substantial number of pull requests and review others' work.
motto: Ship more. Review more. Grow faster.

title: Open Source QA / Tester
description: A 6-month track for quality assurance: run projects locally, file well-documented bug reports, and review pull requests.
motto: Test more. Report more. Break less.

title: Open Source Analyst
description: A 1-year track spanning the full contribution lifecycle: shipping code, filing issues, and reviewing others' pull requests.

title: Open Source Maintainer
description: An 18-month track for sustained, long-term involvement across the full contribution lifecycle - a substantial commitment, but paced for evenings and weekends, not a full-time job.
motto: Show up. Keep shipping. Own it.
